description: Na₂SnTeO₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.75 Å. Sn is bonded to six O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent TeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-31°. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.10 Å. Te is bonded to six O atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-31°. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and four longer (1.96 Å) Te-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sn, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sn, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one Te atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂SnTe tetrahedra.
